focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Plugin 用来扩展 ZCode 的能力。一个插件可以把技能、命令、子智能体、MCP 服务器等能力打包在一起，让团队把可复用的工具沉淀成统一的扩展包，在同一个工作台里一键启用。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="contents">插件里有什么<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">一个插件可以同时包含多种能力。ZCode 会根据插件目录里的内容自动识别它包含哪些组件，并在列表中以标签或数量的形式展示：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">组件</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Skill（技能）</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">教 Agent 如何完成特定任务的技能文件</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Command（命令）</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">可通过 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code> 调用的快捷命令</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Agent（子智能体）</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">随插件一起注册的子智能体</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP 服务器</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">随插件注册的外部工具服务，会出现在 MCP 列表的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Plugin MCP 服务器</strong> 分组中</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Hook（钩子）</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">在特定事件触发的自动化钩子</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">启用插件后，它附带的可运行组件——技能、命令和 MCP 服务器——会注册到当前工作台；停用后这些组件也会一起停用。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="marketplace">浏览与安装插件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; 插件</strong>，看到的就是插件商店。顶部是一个搜索框，输入关键词可以跨所有来源查找插件；下方分成 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">公开</strong> 与 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">个人</strong> 两个分段：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">公开</strong>：ZCode 收录的插件目录，顶部是精选推荐，其余按「开发者工具」「生产力」「实用工具」「指南」「模板」等类别分组，分组内容多时可以展开查看全部。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">个人</strong>：你自己添加的插件市场，先展示推荐条目，其余按市场名称分组。ZCode 已经为你预置了 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Claude Code 的插件市场</strong>，不用自己添加就能在这个分段里浏览和安装；想接入别的来源时，再用右上角的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建</strong> 添加市场源。</li>
</ul>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/plugin/plugin-store-public-annotated.png" alt="插件商店：顶部搜索框、已安装图标带、公开与个人分段，以及按类别分组的插件目录" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">插件页需要在打开工作区后才可用。如果提示「打开一个工作区以管理插件」，先打开任意项目 / 工作区即可。公开目录来自 GitHub，网络访问不畅时目录、详情和安装都可能加载失败；列表没及时更新时，点右上角的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">刷新</strong> 重新拉取。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">找到想要的插件后，点卡片上的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">安装</strong> 即可，状态会依次变为「安装中…」和「已安装」。新装的插件默认启用，组件立即可用。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击任意插件可打开详情页，ZCode 会加载它实际包含的技能、命令、子智能体、MCP 服务器和 Hooks，并附上开发者、类别、版本、网站等信息，让你在安装前先看清它会带来哪些能力。已安装的插件如果有新版本，详情页底部也会直接给出更新入口。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/plugin/plugin-detail-annotated.png" alt="插件详情页：MCP 服务器、技能、命令、子智能体与 Hooks 逐项列出，下方是开发者、类别、版本等信息" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="custom-marketplace">添加自己的插件市场<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">你不必局限于公开目录。点右上角的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建 -&gt; 添加插件市场</strong>，在弹层里指定一个来源即可：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">GitHub 仓库（例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">owner/repo</code> 或其链接）</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">Git URL</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">本地的市场清单文件或目录，也可以直接把文件夹拖进来，或点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">选择目录</strong></li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">添加前 ZCode 会先校验这个市场，成功后它发布的插件会以市场名称分组出现在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">个人</strong> 分段里，你可以像其他插件一样浏览安装。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/plugin/plugin-store-personal-annotated.png" alt="个人分段：自己添加的两个市场，插件按市场名称分组展示" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点搜索框上方的齿轮图标可以打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">市场源</strong> 面板，查看每个市场收录了多少插件、上次更新时间，并单独 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">刷新该市场</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移除该市场</strong>。ZCode 自带的官方目录只能刷新，不会被移除。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/plugin/plugin-marketplace-sources-annotated.png" alt="市场源面板：每个市场的插件数量与更新时间，自建市场带刷新和移除按钮" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">想自己做一个插件或搭建团队市场？见下方 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#develop">开发自己的插件</a>，里面有插件目录结构、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugin.json</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">marketplace.json</code> 的字段速查和完整 JSON 用例。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="built-in">内置插件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 内置了一批 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">官方插件</strong>。其中两个开箱即用、默认启用；其余随包内置，需要时再开启即可。</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">插件</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">能力</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认状态</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">document-skills</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">用于生成 DOCX、PDF 等文档的内置技能</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认启用</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">skill-creator</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">创建和编辑你自己的本地技能</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认启用</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">android-emulator</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">Android 开发工作流与模拟器自动化</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认关闭</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">ios-simulator</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">iOS 开发工作流与模拟器自动化（macOS）</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认关闭</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">restore-legacy-sessions</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">迁移并恢复旧版本的会话</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认关闭</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">其中最值得一提的是 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">android-emulator</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">ios-simulator</strong> 这两个移动开发插件——启用后，ZCode Agent 就能直接驱动 Android 模拟器或 iOS 模拟器，把构建运行、安装启动、界面验证等环节都放进同一条对话流里，不必再在 IDE、模拟器和命令行之间来回切换，移动开发体验更连贯、更高效。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="manage">管理插件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">装过插件后，搜索框下方会出现一条 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已安装</strong> 图标带，点图标直接进入该插件详情。点这一行右侧的齿轮图标，则进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">管理已安装</strong> 页面，本机所有插件会以列表形式展开，显示名称、版本、来源标签和它包含的组件数量。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/plugin/plugin-manage-installed-annotated.webp" alt="管理已安装：插件列表带版本、来源标签、可更新标记与启用开关" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在这里可以完成几件事：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">通过右上角的筛选器按启用 / 停用状态过滤。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">查看插件来源标签，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">内置</code>，或某个市场的名称。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">通过右侧开关启用或停用插件。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">检查更新</strong>，让 ZCode 拉取各插件的最新版本，有更新的插件会带上标记。注意版本对比的口径：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">「最新版本」取自市场 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">marketplace.json</code> 里该插件条目声明的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">version</code>，「已安装版本」取自插件自身的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugin.json</code></strong>。如果市场条目发版时忘了更新 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">version</code>，即使插件代码已更新也不会提示可更新；自建市场发版务必同步修改 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">marketplace.json</code>。检测结果基于本地缓存的市场清单，怀疑不准时先到市场源面板 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">刷新该市场</strong> 再检查。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击插件条目，查看它包含的具体技能、命令、MCP 等组件，并可在此卸载。内置官方插件同样可以卸载。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">由于插件变更需要重新加载 Agent 运行环境，启用或停用插件后，ZCode 会自动刷新受影响的技能和会话，让改动生效。停用插件后，它的全部组件会立即从会话中移除，再次启用即可恢复。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">停用还是卸载？</strong> 停用只是让插件暂时不生效，随时可以开回来；卸载则把它从列表中移除。内置插件的安装包随应用一起分发，卸载它时 ZCode 会记录一条屏蔽标记，应用升级后也不会把它装回来——想重新使用，在市场里重新安装即可。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在远程工作区里，本机装的插件默认不会跟过去。连上 SSH 或 WSL 远程后，可以用工作区标题栏 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步</strong> 下拉里的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步 Plugin</strong> 把它们搬过去，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">管理已安装</strong> 页面右上角也有同样的入口，详见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/remote-development#remote-sync">远程开发 → 把本地配置同步到远端</a>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="configure">配置插件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有些插件需要你先提供参数才能工作，例如默认设备、开关或路径。点开插件详情，展开底部的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">高级信息</strong>，在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">配置</strong> 区填写可填项——必填项会标注「必填」，填完点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">保存配置</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">标记为敏感的项（例如 API 密钥）会提示「该值需要安全存储接入后才能配置」，当前暂不支持在界面里直接填写。遇到这类插件，按其说明在系统层面准备好密钥即可。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="using">装好的插件怎么用<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">插件启用后，它带来的能力会自动出现在客户端对应位置，无需额外设置：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">能力</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">在哪里用</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">技能</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">合适时机会自动触发；也可在输入框输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code>，从「技能」分组手动选用。在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; 技能</strong> 的「Plugin 技能」分组可统一查看。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">命令</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">在输入框输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code>，从「命令」分组选用，可输入关键词搜索命令或技能。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">子智能体</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">会话中可被自动调度执行任务；在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; 子智能体</strong> 的「插件子智能体」分组可查看（来自插件，只读）。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP 服务器</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; MCP</strong> 中显示为 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Plugin MCP 服务器</strong>，随插件启停自动加载。</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="develop">开发自己的插件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">只需会写 JSON 和 Markdown，不用改 ZCode 本体。做好后，通过上面的 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#custom-marketplace">添加自己的插件市场</a> 把本地目录加进来，即可在客户端里直接安装测试。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="structure">一个插件长什么样<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">插件就是一个文件夹：根目录放一份清单 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugin.json</code>，再按需放各类组件目录（全部可选）。</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">my-plugin/
├── .zcode-plugin/
│   └── plugin.json    清单（唯一必需）
├── commands/          斜杠命令，每个一个 .md
├── skills/            技能，每个子目录含 SKILL.md
├── agents/            子智能体 .md
├── hooks/hooks.json   钩子
└── .mcp.json          MCP 服务声明
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">清单位置按优先级查找：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode-plugin/plugin.json</code>（推荐）→ <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.claude-plugin/plugin.json</code>（兼容 Claude Code）。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">五种组件的写法：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">组件</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">格式与位置</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">命令</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">commands/*.md</code>，YAML frontmatter + 正文；正文用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">$ARGUMENTS</code> 接收参数</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">技能</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">skills/&lt;名&gt;/SKILL.md</code>，frontmatter 写清 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">description</code>，描述越准越易被自动触发</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">子智能体</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">agents/*.md</code>，frontmatter 必填 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">description</code>，正文即其 system prompt</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Hooks</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code>，在特定事件时机自动执行；随插件启停，详见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/hooks">Hooks</a></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP 服务</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">根目录 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.mcp.json</code> 或清单 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mcpServers</code>，接入外部工具，键名自动加命名空间避免冲突</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">最小清单只需要一个 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name</code>：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;name&quot;: &quot;hello-world&quot;,
  &quot;version&quot;: &quot;0.1.0&quot;,
  &quot;description&quot;: &quot;我的第一个插件&quot;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="plugin-json">plugin.json 字段速查<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">字段</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">必填</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">含义</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">✅</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">插件名，须匹配 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$</code>（小写字母 / 数字开头，可含 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">. _ -</code>，1–128 字符）</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">version</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">版本号，缺省 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">0.0.0</code>，建议语义化版本</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">description</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">一句话描述，显示在插件管理界面</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">author</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">dependencies</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">依赖的其他插件，写 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name@market</code> 或同市场内裸 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">userConfig</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">用户可配置项（见下表）</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">清单里写了 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">channels</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">lspServers</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">outputStyles</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">settings</code> 这几个字段时，当前运行时<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅登记、不执行</strong>，会给出诊断提示，不影响其它组件加载。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">userConfig</code> 里的每一项都会出现在插件详情弹窗的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">配置</strong> 区，供用户在界面里填写：</p>

<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">敏感配置（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">sensitive</code>）的值可以在 MCP 声明里用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">${user_config.键}</code> 引用。</p>

<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">「插件市场」是一份目录清单，告诉客户端有哪些插件可装、各自在哪。</p>

<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">source</code> 的几种写法：</strong></p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">写法</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">含义</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&quot;./plugins/hello&quot;</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">最常用。相对市场根目录的子目录（插件与市场同仓库）</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{ &quot;source&quot;: &quot;directory&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;/abs/path&quot; }</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">本地绝对路径目录</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{ &quot;source&quot;: &quot;github&quot;, &quot;repo&quot;: &quot;owner/repo&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;subdir&quot;, &quot;ref&quot;: &quot;main&quot; }</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">从 GitHub 仓库取，可指定子目录与分支</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{ &quot;source&quot;: &quot;git&quot;, &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://...git&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;subdir&quot;, &quot;ref&quot;: &quot;...&quot; }</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">从任意 Git 仓库取</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{ &quot;source&quot;: &quot;file&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;...&quot; }</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">读取一个本地清单文件</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{ &quot;source&quot;: &quot;url&quot;, &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://.../marketplace.json&quot; }</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">指向一个 JSON 文件的 HTTP 地址，可带 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">headers</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{ &quot;source&quot;: &quot;npm&quot;, &quot;package&quot;: &quot;...&quot; }</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">从 npm 包取</td></tr></tbody></table></div>

px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">argument-hint</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">参数提示，如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&quot;[topic]&quot;</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">allowed-tools</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">逗号分隔，限制该命令可用的工具</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">model</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">覆盖默认模型</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">skills</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">逗号分隔，自动挂载的技能</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">disable-noninteractive</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">布尔；是否在非交互模式下禁用</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">正文里 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">$ARGUMENTS</code> 代表用户传入的全部参数，<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">$1</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">$2</code> 代表位置参数。命令名取自文件名，须匹配 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_:-]{0,63}$</code>。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="skill-frontmatter">技能 SKILL.md 字段速查<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">skills/&lt;名&gt;/SKILL.md</code> 的 frontmatter 支持以下字段：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">字段</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">必填</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">含义</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">✅</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">技能名，缺省取所在目录名</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">description</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">✅</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">触发说明，写清「什么时候用」；最长 1024 字符，越准越易被自动调用</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">when_to_use</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">补充触发时机描述</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">license</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">许可证</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">metadata</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">对象，可放 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">author</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">version</code> 等附加信息</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">其余非白名单字段（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">homepage</code>）会被忽略，不影响加载。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="examples">完整 JSON 用例<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<h4 class="group min-w-0 text-xl font-semibold mt-6 mb-2 text-foreground" id="example-plugin-json">plugin.json（全字段）<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h4>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;name&quot;: &quot;ios-simulator&quot;,
  &quot;version&quot;: &quot;1.2.0&quot;,
  &quot;description&quot;: &quot;iOS 模拟器开发循环：技能 + 命令 + MCP + 钩子&quot;,
  &quot;author&quot;: { &quot;name&quot;: &quot;你的名字&quot;, &quot;email&quot;: &quot;you@example.com&quot;, &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://example.com&quot; },
  &quot;homepage&quot;: &quot;https://example.com/ios-simulator&quot;,
  &quot;repository&quot;: &quot;https://github.com/your-team/ios-simulator&quot;,
  &quot;license&quot;: &quot;MIT&quot;,
  &quot;keywords&quot;: [&quot;ios&quot;, &quot;simulator&quot;, &quot;mobile&quot;],
  &quot;commands&quot;: &quot;commands&quot;,
  &quot;skills&quot;: [&quot;skills&quot;, &quot;extra-skills&quot;],
  &quot;agents&quot;: &quot;agents&quot;,
  &quot;hooks&quot;: &quot;hooks/hooks.json&quot;,
  &quot;mcpServers&quot;: &quot;.mcp.json&quot;,
  &quot;dependencies&quot;: [&quot;skill-creator@zcode-plugins-official&quot;],
  &quot;userConfig&quot;: {
    &quot;api_key&quot;: {
      &quot;title&quot;: &quot;API 密钥&quot;,
      &quot;description&quot;: &quot;访问第三方服务用&quot;,
      &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
      &quot;required&quot;: true,
      &quot;sensitive&quot;: true
    },
    &quot;default_device&quot;: { &quot;title&quot;: &quot;默认设备&quot;, &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;, &quot;default&quot;: &quot;iPhone 16&quot; },
    &quot;max_retries&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;number&quot;, &quot;default&quot;: 3 },
    &quot;verbose&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;boolean&quot;, &quot;default&quot;: false },
    &quot;workspace_dir&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;directory&quot; },
    &quot;config_file&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;file&quot; }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">commands</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">skills</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mcpServers</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">agents</code> 三种写法均可——目录字符串（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&quot;commands&quot;</code>）、路径数组（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">[&quot;skills&quot;, &quot;extra-skills&quot;]</code>）、或直接内联对象。上例分别演示了字符串、数组与文件路径。</p>
<h4 class="group min-w-0 text-xl font-semibold mt-6 mb-2 text-foreground" id="example-marketplace-json">marketplace.json（全字段 + 所有 source 写法）<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h4>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;name&quot;: &quot;my-market&quot;,
  &quot;description&quot;: &quot;团队内部插件市场&quot;,
  &quot;pluginRoot&quot;: &quot;plugins&quot;,
  &quot;allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn&quot;: [&quot;zcode-plugins-official&quot;],
  &quot;plugins&quot;: [
    {
      &quot;name&quot;: &quot;hello-world&quot;,
      &quot;source&quot;: &quot;./hello-world&quot;,
      &quot;description&quot;: &quot;打招呼插件&quot;,
      &quot;version&quot;: &quot;0.1.0&quot;,
      &quot;category&quot;: &quot;demo&quot;,
      &quot;tags&quot;: [&quot;starter&quot;, &quot;demo&quot;],
      &quot;strict&quot;: true
    },
    {
      &quot;name&quot;: &quot;from-github&quot;,
      &quot;source&quot;: { &quot;source&quot;: &quot;github&quot;, &quot;repo&quot;: &quot;your-team/another&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;plugins/x&quot;, &quot;ref&quot;: &quot;main&quot; },
      &quot;dependencies&quot;: [&quot;hello-world&quot;, &quot;skill-creator@zcode-plugins-official&quot;]
    },
    {
      &quot;name&quot;: &quot;from-git&quot;,
      &quot;source&quot;: { &quot;source&quot;: &quot;git&quot;, &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://git.example.com/x.git&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;sub&quot;, &quot;ref&quot;: &quot;v1.0&quot; }
    },
    {
      &quot;name&quot;: &quot;from-dir&quot;,
      &quot;source&quot;: { &quot;source&quot;: &quot;directory&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;/abs/path/to/plugin&quot; }
    },
    {
      &quot;name&quot;: &quot;from-url&quot;,
      &quot;source&quot;: { &quot;source&quot;: &quot;url&quot;, &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://example.com/plugin-manifest.json&quot;, &quot;headers&quot;: { &quot;Authorization&quot;: &quot;Bearer xxx&quot; } }
    },
    {
      &quot;name&quot;: &quot;from-npm&quot;,
      &quot;source&quot;: { &quot;source&quot;: &quot;npm&quot;, &quot;package&quot;: &quot;@scope/plugin&quot; }
    }
  ]
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">设了 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">pluginRoot</code> 后，相对 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">source</code>（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&quot;./hello-world&quot;</code>）以它为基准解析，即 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugins/hello-world</code>。</p>
<h4 class="group min-w-0 text-xl font-semibold mt-6 mb-2 text-foreground" id="example-hooks-json">hooks/hooks.json<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h4>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;hooks&quot;: {
    &quot;SessionStart&quot;: [
      {
        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;startup|clear|compact&quot;,
        &quot;hooks&quot;: [
          {
            &quot;type&quot;: &quot;command&quot;,
            &quot;command&quot;: &quot;\&quot;${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh\&quot; start&quot;,
            &quot;async&quot;: false,
            &quot;shell&quot;: true,
            &quot;timeout&quot;: 30,
            &quot;statusMessage&quot;: &quot;初始化中…&quot;
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    &quot;PreToolUse&quot;: [
      {
        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;Bash&quot;,
        &quot;hooks&quot;: [
          {
            &quot;type&quot;: &quot;process&quot;,
            &quot;command&quot;: &quot;node&quot;,
            &quot;args&quot;: [&quot;${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/check.js&quot;],
            &quot;timeoutMs&quot;: 5000,
            &quot;statusMessage&quot;: &quot;校验命令…&quot;
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    &quot;PostToolUse&quot;: [
      { &quot;hooks&quot;: [ { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;command&quot;, &quot;command&quot;: &quot;echo done&quot; } ] }
    ],
    &quot;Stop&quot;: [
      { &quot;hooks&quot;: [ { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;command&quot;, &quot;command&quot;: &quot;\&quot;${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/cleanup.sh\&quot;&quot;, &quot;async&quot;: true } ] }
    ]
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">当前支持 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">SessionStart</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">UserPromptSubmit</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PreToolUse</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PermissionRequest</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PostToolUse</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PostToolUseFailure</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Stop</code> 七个事件。每个事件下是 matcher 组数组；<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">process</code> 使用 argv 执行，<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">command</code> 使用 shell 字符串并支持 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">async</code>。标准位置 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code> 会自动发现，不要再在 manifest 中重复指向同一文件。插件启用后 Hook 才进入新 session，完整语义见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/hooks">Hooks</a>。</p>
<h4 class="group min-w-0 text-xl font-semibold mt-6 mb-2 text-foreground" id="example-mcp-json">.mcp.json（stdio + http + sse）<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h4>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;mcpServers&quot;: {
    &quot;ios-simulator&quot;: {
      &quot;type&quot;: &quot;stdio&quot;,
      &quot;command&quot;: &quot;node&quot;,
      &quot;args&quot;: [&quot;${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/mcp/server.js&quot;],
      &quot;cwd&quot;: &quot;${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}&quot;,
      &quot;env&quot;: {
        &quot;IOS_SIM_ROOT&quot;: &quot;${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}&quot;,
        &quot;IOS_SIM_DEVICE&quot;: &quot;${user_config.default_device}&quot;
      },
      &quot;enabled&quot;: true,
      &quot;timeoutMs&quot;: 60000
    },
    &quot;remote-http&quot;: {
      &quot;type&quot;: &quot;http&quot;,
      &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://mcp.example.com/api&quot;,
      &quot;headers&quot;: { &quot;Authorization&quot;: &quot;Bearer ${user_config.api_key}&quot; },
      &quot;enabled&quot;: true,
      &quot;timeoutMs&quot;: 30000
    },
    &quot;remote-sse&quot;: {
      &quot;type&quot;: &quot;sse&quot;,
      &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://mcp.example.com/sse&quot;,
      &quot;headers&quot;: { &quot;X-Token&quot;: &quot;${user_config.api_key}&quot; }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">type</code> 可省略——有 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">command</code> 默认 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">stdio</code>，有 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">url</code> 默认 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">http</code>。可用模板变量：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">变量</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">含义</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">插件根目录，亦可写 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">插件数据目录</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">当前工作目录</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">${user_config.键}</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">引用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">userConfig</code> 中对应配置项的值</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">服务键名会自动加命名空间 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugin:&lt;插件名&gt;:&lt;服务名&gt;</code> 避免冲突。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="local-testing">在客户端本地测试<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">本地建好插件目录，再写一份 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">marketplace.json</code>，<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugins[].source</code> 用相对路径指向插件目录。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; 插件</strong>，点右上角 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建 -&gt; 添加插件市场</strong>，填该目录的本地路径（本地路径需真实存在）。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">个人</strong> 分段找到它，点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">安装</strong> 并启用，在会话里触发组件验证；改完代码回到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">市场源</strong> 面板刷新该市场即可。</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="distribute">做一个市场分发给团队<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">把插件放进市场仓库的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugins/</code> 目录，根目录写 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">marketplace.json</code> 列出条目，推到 GitHub。队友点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建 -&gt; 添加插件市场</strong> 填仓库地址，即可一次拿到全部插件。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">自带的官方插件是最好的范例（skill-creator 最简，ios-simulator / android-emulator 最完整）。从纯技能插件起步，跑通后再加命令、Hooks、MCP。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">安全提示</strong>：启用插件就是授予代码执行信任。已启用的第三方市场插件与官方插件一样，可以执行本地进程并读取继承的 Agent 环境变量。启用前请审查来源、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code> 和脚本，不信任时停用或卸载插件。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
